sources.entry: OmegaStar - Turns the Claude Code you already use, with its browser, models and logins, into a team of AI employees with scoped objectives, who learn by talking and keep each lesson as a skill. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/itsfutsy/OmegaStar) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.one_liner: A desktop app (Tauri 2, Rust and React) that turns your existing Claude Code install into a team of AI employees with roles, an org chart that includes real people, schedules and skills that grow as you teach them.
keywords: run ai agents on my computer
automate my daily work with claude
manage a team of ai agents
summary.what_it_does: OmegaStar wraps your own Claude Code CLI so each AI employee is a headless `claude -p` process running under your login, with the tools, logins and skills you already have. You hire employees from templates or from blank, give each a title, objective and skills, and place them on an org chart alongside real people with their roles and contact channels. Employees can run on schedules, have managers and colleagues they delegate to or ask for help, and reach people through tools you have allowed. You teach them through conversation, and each lesson is written into a named, versioned skill that can be undone, with periodic tidying of skills. An Inbox collects only items that need your approval or input, and an Activity page shows what each employee is doing. Employees run in a Supervised mode by default, which blocks tools you have not allowed.
use_cases: run recurring admin or support tasks with Claude Code on a schedule
build a small team of specialist AI agents for a project or business
delegate routine work to an autonomous agent that uses my existing CLI tools
approve or deny agent actions from a single inbox
teach an agent new tasks by conversation and keep them as reusable skills
manage an AI agent setup without writing glue scripts or cron jobs
how_to_run: Install Claude Code and confirm it is signed in (`claude auth status` shows `loggedIn: true`).
Download the installer from the latest release: .dmg (Apple Silicon Macs), -setup.exe (Windows), or .AppImage (Linux).
Open the app, complete setup (company, name, title), and optionally enable running in the background at login.
Hire your first employee from a template such as Chief of Staff, then send the opening lesson in the conversation.
To build from source: clone the repo, run `npm install`, then `npm run tauri dev` (or `npm run tauri build` for installers).
notable: Every employee is your own Claude Code run headless, with no separate agent loop, API client or hosting required
Org chart includes real people with roles, strengths and contact channels, plus manager and delegation relationships
Skills grow from conversation, are stored as named skills, and every edit can be undone
Supervised mode blocks any tool you have not allowed until you approve it with Allow once or Always allow
Schedules run from the system tray and catch up once after the computer was off or asleep
caveats: Claude Code only; no other models are supported, and it works only while the computer is on and awake
Employees run as you with no sandbox, and it is one person on one computer rather than a shared team tool
Windows build is unsigned, and the Windows build must be made from PowerShell or cmd rather than Git Bash; macOS download is Apple Silicon only
Pro and Max plan limits suit ordinary use; heavy or round-the-clock schedules need an API key or Team/Enterprise plan
